body.name: v2.13.0
body.body:
Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.13.0` with dist-tag `latest`.

## New Features

- Lab: CL-06 routing compatibility policy; CL-07 task effectiveness evidence; CL-08 bounded automation with trusted live-route dispatch; CL-09 passive production evidence (#1394, #1438, #1447, #1489)
- Import Cockpit Tools accounts through safe adapters (#1357)
- Providers: Add Novita AI preset; Add Nous Portal (Nous Research) OAuth provider — device grant + free/paid live catalog (#1318, #1397)
- Codex: Coordinate reset-credit recovery attempts; Show per-account usage (#1410, #1488)
- Ultra mode toggle — proactive delegation for every model/effort (#1209)

## Bug Fixes

- Responses: Restore DeepSeek streaming and routed code-mode tools; Reject unscoped reasoning replay; Bind reasoning replay to route identity (#1361, #1474, #1505)
- Treat local CI checklist as author attestation (#1437)
- Oauth: Guard expires_in parsing against NaN across token responses; Continue manual flow when callback port is occupied; Harden generated account ids against collisions (#1418, #1476, #1513)
- Align WSL Codex home ownership (#1427)
- Reconcile PR from head SHA when the commit-PR index lags (#1445)
- Recognize Codex Team plans in pool capacity; Add per-model structured output opt-out; [WRONG BRANCH] tmp: rebase #1470 onto dev; [WRONG BRANCH] tmp: rebase #1474 onto dev; [WRONG BRANCH] tmp: rebase #1484 onto dev (#1443, #1424, #1490, #1492, #1495)
- Preserve hosted web search choices (#1428)
- Scope catalog-state guidance to what we can attribute (#1407)
- Codex: Honor split SQLite state homes; Preflight sync injection before catalog writes; Keep collaboration guidance before conversation; Fence native reads for foreign service-home ownership (#1425, #1461, #1380, #1470)
- Apply providerContextCaps.openai to native OpenAI rows (#1435)
- Prevent accidental Add Provider modal dismissal (#1481)
- Tolerate null tool-call padding (#1468)
- Route OpenCode Go Luna through Responses (#1484)
- Preserve parallel reasoning replay (#1501)
- Forward structured output schemas (#1464)
- Cli: Bind local diagnostic reads to runtime; Follow up on local diagnostic review findings (#1448, #1516)
- Preserve cyber-policy request logs (#1511)

## Documentation

- Table-safe Kiro install pipes in translations; fix live-test account read (follow-up to #1397) (#1450)

## Chores

- Await proxy teardown before cleanup (#1414)
- Cli: Move CLI head dispatch into src/cli/root.ts; Add command registry as single metadata source; Registry-driven command dispatch module; Normalize process exit through dispatchCommand; Fold internal-dispatch and pin help banner; Add focused dispatch behavior tests (#1444, #1446, #1451, #1455, #1456, #1457)
- Isolate Bun test shards into fresh-process batches; Classify Bun epoll faults as runtime crashes (#1469, #1475)
- Align transaction timeout budget (#1507)

## Other Changes

- Add Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) localization for GUI, README, and docs (resync); [WRONG BRANCH] tmp: rebase #1476 onto dev (#1440, #1493)

Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.11.1` with dist-tag `latest`.

## New Features

- Make sidecar reasoning model-aware (#1238)

- Add OMP client support (#1109)

## Bug Fixes

- Treat a data frame that parses to a non-record as malformed (#1219) (#1240)
- Codex: Stop reporting every history failure as a Codex DB lock; Warn when codex-shim install cannot prove routing (#1169); Read feature flags from a TOML parse, not a line scanner (#1295); Persist account deletion before cleanup; Preserve routed models in desktop picker (#1202, #1289, #1309, #1319, #1244)
- Keep per-provider context caps independent (#1224)
- Google: Replay Vertex thought signatures; Discover Antigravity live models; Anchor the CCA session id on the client thread id (#1297) (#1266, #1178, #1311)
- Ignore empty data: frames; tighten unspaced [DONE] test (#1249)
- Catalog: Restore DeepSeek V4 context window on routed rebuilds; Synthesize incomplete combo members with context fallback (#1163) (#1226, #1305)
- Stream request-history index ingestion (#1189) (#1287)
- Prefer Grok weekly credits for xAI dashboard (#1290)
- Keep unbound account quota unknown (#1195) (#1288)
- Drop a removed provider's custom models (#1273) (#1293)

- Accept equivalent structured bug evidence (#1173)

Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.10.1` with dist-tag `latest`.

## New Features

- Add default_mode_request_user_input feature toggle (#911)
- Add ClinePass subscription provider (#880)
- Providers: Add Command Code preset with live model discovery; Manage provider headers via PATCH and ocx provider edit --headers (#959) (#923, #1033)
- Codex: Add exact account routing; Add encrypted native main profiles; Classify reset-eligible quota rejection; Add account-qualified catalog entries; A write substrate that survives being interrupted (#671, #863, #866, #949, #998)
- Gui: Show weighted Codex pool capacity and next recovery; Fixed action toasts for dashboard sync + model-apply feedback (#878, #1050)
- Report A6API credit usage (#693)
- Ci: Require UI screenshot evidence for PRs mentioning gui; Draft contributor PRs until review-readiness checklist is complete; Verify checklist claims and reset readiness on head drift (#960, #969, #986)
- Render OpenAI-style release notes with optional LLM polish (#957)
- Opt-in same-target 429 wait-and-retry before key failover (#487) (#865)
- Routing: Record durable route decision traces; Add validated routing policy profiles; Execute capability-aware policy profiles; Add evidence-based route health scoring; Add quota-aware policy scoring; Add cost-aware policy scoring and limits (#1003, #1011, #1012, #1013, #1014, #1015)
- Control-Plane: Add indexed cursor-paginated request history; Expose route decision explanations (#1004, #1016)
- Add route reliability and latency analytics (#1005)
- Provider opt-in sparse lifecycle snapshot repair (#893) (#1025)

## Bug Fixes

- Bound the six remaining retained-state leaks (#820 wave 2); Preserve hosted image tool preferences (#837 rebased, two defects fixed); Fix 6 React Doctor findings and pin the CI engine to 0.9.3 (#892, #924, #931)
- Close the agent star-consent bypass found auditing the #892 merge (#917)
- Openai-Chat: Deliver tool-result images to vision models; Enforce type:"object" on all tool parameters, not just Kimi (#912, #933)

body.body:
Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.9.0` with dist-tag `latest`.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 0ab92b8ce4f8a41c24056df01730fddf4cfbebbf -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat(providers): add DeepInfra preset by @olddonkey in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/747
* feat(providers): add Hyperbolic preset by @olddonkey in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/751

* feat(issues): add orthogonal area labels for triage by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/830
* feat(export): client config export for Pi and OpenCode by @lidge-jun in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/852
### Bug Fixes
* fix(service): make Windows scheduler stop actually stop the proxy by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/780
* fix(providers): add China Coding Plan baseUrl choice for Alibaba by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/776
* fix(openai-chat): complete streams that end after output without terminal by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/793
* fix(providers): default DeepSeek V4 Flash to Responses by @estelledc in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/808
* fix(cursor): support current Grok 4.5 Fast wire IDs by @jbaehova in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/797
* fix(service): bake WinSW admin env and retry stop-path probes by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/805
* fix(logs): raise in-memory log buffer and support limit/offset by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/784
* fix(providers): manage default provider safely by @eachann1024 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/810
* fix(codex): persist refreshed pool account plans by @luvs01 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/750
* fix(storage): await Worker exit before isolate reclaim on Windows by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/813
* fix(security): allow TLS terminator Origin scheme skew for management by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/779
* fix(security): retry required ACL harden after soft timeout by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/782
* fix(catalog): prioritize model names in picker labels by @songwunil in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/763
* fix(codex): preserve auto-compaction limit on inject by @Ingwannu in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/832
* fix(cli): authenticate Codex health with admin token by @Ingwannu in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/835
* fix(catalog): preserve on-disk rows on default sync by @Ingwannu in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/836
* fix(oauth): normalize Antigravity refresh margin by @Ingwannu in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/831
* fix(router): pin Codex auto review to OpenAI by @Ingwannu in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/833
* fix(codex): distinguish exhausted quota from unknown by @Ingwannu in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/834
* fix(gui): stop revisit flashes and layout shift across dashboard tabs by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/824
* fix(storage): await Worker join in test beforeEach under isolate by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/827
* fix(update): recover Windows dashboard proxy after self-update by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/838
### Documentation
* docs(providers): name the Volcengine maintenance owner and record its evidence by @lidge-jun in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/826
### Chores
* test(windows): retry one transient CIM enumeration timeout by @luvs01 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/801
* test(storage): cap macOS isolate worker churn to avoid Bun segfault by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/849
### Other Changes
* Zero-leak state stores: hard caps, durable spill, and generation-fenced sweeping by @lidge-jun in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/829

* @estelledc made their first contribution in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/808

body.body:
Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.7.40` with dist-tag `latest`.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at b0413c6e18522232d42d23b58c420c335ea881ee -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat(gui): configure Codex auto-switch threshold by @csa906 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/337
* feat(gui): Dashboard workspace view + drop Providers classic toggle by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/428
* feat(gui): improve models workspace layout stability by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/438
* feat(gui): Subagents workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/441
* feat(gui): Usage workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/442
* feat(gui): API Keys workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/444
* feat(gui): Claude Code workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/446
### Bug Fixes
* fix(claude): sanitize WebSearch domain filters for routed models by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/383
* fix(codex): clear stale weekly quota on WHAM/header refresh (#382) by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/390
* fix(openai-chat): keep system messages first by @jonathanli12 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/397
* fix(anthropic): guard premature no-tool completions by @duansy123 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/394
* fix(gui): portal select dropdowns to avoid clipping by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/393
* fix(web-search): bound sidecar search deadline to 60s + graceful degradation (#398) by @lidge-jun in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/416
* fix(ci): reject low-effort feature reports in issue-quality bot by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/423
* fix(cursor): stop false shell blocked reports and cmd/command mismatch (#399) by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/402
### Other Changes
* Add inline issue translation to enforce-issue-quality workflow by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/440

## New Contributors
* @duansy123 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/394
* @csa906 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/337

body.body:
Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.7.40-preview.20260725` with dist-tag `preview`.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 66a3c36bf6f687e10d1f7bacd669bf5d4a6a35ed -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat(gui): configure Codex auto-switch threshold by @csa906 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/337
* feat(gui): Dashboard workspace view + drop Providers classic toggle by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/428
* feat(gui): improve models workspace layout stability by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/438

* feat(gui): Usage workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/442
* feat(gui): API Keys workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/444
* feat(gui): Claude Code workspace view by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/446
### Bug Fixes
* fix(claude): sanitize WebSearch domain filters for routed models by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/383
* fix(codex): clear stale weekly quota on WHAM/header refresh (#382) by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/390
* fix(openai-chat): keep system messages first by @jonathanli12 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/397
* fix(anthropic): guard premature no-tool completions by @duansy123 in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/394
* fix(gui): portal select dropdowns to avoid clipping by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/393
* fix(web-search): bound sidecar search deadline to 60s + graceful degradation (#398) by @lidge-jun in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/416
* fix(ci): reject low-effort feature reports in issue-quality bot by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/423
* fix(cursor): stop false shell blocked reports and cmd/command mismatch (#399) by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/402
### Other Changes
* Add inline issue translation to enforce-issue-quality workflow by @Wibias in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/440

## New Contributors
* @duansy123 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/394
* @csa906 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lidge-jun/opencodex/pull/337
